OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About The Opportunity

As a Technical Expert, you will own the core build-out of the company's core infrastructure, proactively identifying and eliminating risks across the delivery pipeline through CI/CD, DevSecOps, Change Management, and AI-Native upgrades—reducing delivery cost while improving quality and efficiency via tooling and automation.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Responsible for the design, development, and evolution of critical services for our company's core infrastructure, ensuring the stability, scalability, and performance of the platform.
• Utilize Kubernetes to build platform capabilities such as environment orchestration, service governance, and traffic scheduling, participate in the implementation of multi-lane isolation, phased rollout, and end-to-end environment solutions.
• Design and develop AI Agent capabilities on the platform side (such as intelligent diagnosis, automated orchestration, natural language operation and maintenance, etc.), and connect the call chain between the Agent and the underlying infrastructure.
• Connect with components such as Kubernetes, Nacos, Apollo, Kong gateways, etc., accumulate reusable platform components and toolchains, and continuously improve research and development efficiency.

What We Look For In You

• Solid Computer Science fundamentals (OS, networking, distributed systems, data structures & algorithms);
• 3+ years of industry experience developing core infrastructure platforms on an enterprise-wide scale;
• Proficient in DevOps toolchains, Kubernetes, and microservice stacks;
• Knowledge of AI / LLM in engineering-efficiency and CI/CD scenarios, with an AI-Native engineering mindset;
• Strong product sense, ownership, and ability to work under pressure;

Perks & Benefits

• Competitive total compensation package
• L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!
